releaseNotes: v1.3.4 -- Fixed connectivity-failure log spam: a single source going unreachable previously logged 2-3 separate warnings every poll cycle for as long as the outage lasted (dozens of near-identical lines for one ongoing problem). Now only the transition into/out of unreachable logs a warning; Full-tier logging still shows every attempt for active troubleshooting. Also added a Help & Support section to the main page (community thread link, support link). Also includes v1.3.3 (retry-once on a known older-firmware bug that intermittently returns garbled data instead of a real response, reducing false 'asleep' reports; new Tips page section documenting it) and v1.3.2 (fixed a false negative in PTZ Calibration detection).
author: jdthomas24
